# 实验证明ChatGPT依赖Google搜索结果摘要

- 作者：Flavio Amiel（@fba）
- 原帖发布时间：2025-07-28 14:07（北京时间）
- 原帖：https://x.com/fba/status/1949713208383517061
- 收藏日期：2026-10-29

## 中文全文

1. @aleyda 揭示了 ChatGPT 如何依赖 Google 搜索结果页摘要来生成回答，更多内容见：
https://x.com/aleyda/status/1948405086859690368

### 原帖中的引用预览（非被引用文章全文）

[Aleyda Solis 🕊️ @aleyda](<https://x.com/aleyda/status/1948405086859690368>)

🚨 已确认：ChatGPT 会使用 Google 搜索结果页摘要来作答！下面是我做的一个有证据支持的测试：

我做了一个简单、而且很容易复现的测试，确认 ChatGPT 的回答依赖 Google 搜索结果页摘要。测试表明：

1. 基本上，只有在 Google 开始将该页面显示在搜索结果页之后，ChatGPT 才能给出回答，而当时 Bing 还没有收录这个页面。

2. ChatGPT 确认，它给出的回答并不完整，是通过“从页面公开收录的版本中获取一段摘要……通过能预览页面内容的网页搜索——很可能来自搜索引擎索引”来作答的。

3. 对比 ChatGPT 给出的摘要回答与 Google 搜索结果页中的摘要后，我确认两者完全相同！

这是我的完整文章，包含测试步骤和结果：https://www.aleydasolis.com/en/ai-search/chatgpt-uses-google-serp-snippets-for-answers/

附言：我想，这又是传统 SEO 并未消亡的一个理由。它也再次说明，Google 的领先之处不只有搜索索引：即使页面尚未被 Google 收录，Gemini 也能够直接抓取页面，给出准确回答；而不是像 ChatGPT 那样，依赖来自……Google 的搜索结果摘要，给出不完整、不准确的回答。😂

## 英文原文

1. @aleyda uncovers how ChatGPT relies on Google SERP snippets to generate answers, check out more about it here: 
https://x.com/aleyda/status/1948405086859690368

### Quoted preview

[Aleyda Solis 🕊️ @aleyda](<https://x.com/aleyda/status/1948405086859690368>)

🚨 Confirmed - ChatGPT uses Google SERP Snippets for its Answers! Here's a test I've run with proof:

I’ve run a simple but straight-forward to follow test that confirms the reliance of ChatGPT on Google SERPs snippets for its answers, showing that:

1. ChatGPT pretty much was able to give an answer *only* after Google had started to show the page in its SERPs, while the page wasn't being indexed in Bing yet

2. ChatGPT confirmed it was providing an answer (which was incomplete) by "fetching a snippet from the publicly indexed version of the page...  via web search that previews the page content – likely from search engine indexing“.

3. When comparing the snippet answer given by ChatGPT vs the one of Google SERPs: I confirmed it was the same!

Here's my full article with the steps and outcome of the test: https://www.aleydasolis.com/en/ai-search/chatgpt-uses-google-serp-snippets-for-answers/

PS: I guess this is yet another reason why traditional SEO is not dead and shows once again how ahead Google is not only with their search index, but the way Gemini is able to just go and fetch the page to give an accurate answer even when the page wasn’t yet indexed by Google still, rather than a incomplete, inaccurate one like ChatGPT, relying on search results snippets from… Google. 😂
